title: PersonalQuery-Benchmark:Evaluating Retrieval Robustness to Personalized User Expression Differences
abstract: arXiv:2610.32164v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Existing personalized information retrieval methods mainly model differences in user needs through user preferences and query intent, while paying little attention to the personalized expression differences that arise when different users express the same retrieval need. Existing real query data typically lack stable user identities, long-term expression histories, and intent-matched counterparts, making it difficult to systematically evaluate the impact of personalized expression differences on retrieval outcomes. To this end, we propose PersonalQuery-Benchmark (PQB). PQB models personalized syntactic expression and personalized writing errors from users' historical texts, constructs personalized syntactic expression queries and personalized writing-error queries, and validates benchmark quality through LLM assessment and independent human evaluation. translated_title: PersonalQuery-Benchmark：评估检索系统对个性化用户表达差异的鲁棒性
translated_abstract: 现有的个性化信息检索方法主要通过用户偏好和查询意图来建模用户需求的差异，而很少关注不同用户在表达同一检索需求时产生的个性化表达差异。现有的真实查询数据通常缺乏稳定的用户身份、长期的表达历史以及意图匹配的对应项，因而难以系统地评估个性化表达差异对检索结果的影响。为此，我们提出了 PersonalQuery-Benchmark（PQB）。PQB 从用户的历史文本中建模个性化句法表达和个性化书写错误，构建了个性化句法表达查询和个性化书写错误查询，并通过大语言模型评估和独立的人类评价来验证基准的质量。PQB 涵盖三个 Amazon 产品领域，共包含 6,516 个查询实例。
tldr: 该论文提出了首个系统性基准 PQB，通过从用户历史文本中建模个性化句法表达和书写错误构建 6,516 个查询实例，用以评估检索系统对同一需求下不同用户个性化表达差异的鲁棒性。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces PersonalQuery-Benchmark (PQB), the first benchmark to systematically evaluate retrieval robustness to personalized expression differences—such as personalized syntactic expression and writing errors—across three Amazon product domains with 6,516 query instances.
